      default @NonNull SerdeRegistry cloneWithConfiguration(@Nullable SerdeConfiguration configuration, @Nullable SerializationConfiguration serializationConfiguration, @Nullable DeserializationConfiguration deserializationConfiguration)
      Optional feature. Create a new SerdeRegistry with the given configuration values. A null parameter indicates the old configuration should be used.
      Parameters:
      configuration - The SerdeConfiguration
      serializationConfiguration - The SerializationConfiguration
      deserializationConfiguration - The DeserializationConfiguration
